name: Yukon
title: Yukon Rebate Calculator 2026: Good Energy Heat Pump Rebates
h1: Yukon Rebate Calculator 2026: What You Could Get Back
desc: Free Yukon rebate calculator. The Affordable Heat Pump Program, 50% heat pump rebates, window, wood heat and Dependable Grid rebates. Every number sourced.
intro: Answer a few questions and see which Yukon rebates fit your home, with a source for every number.
short: Yukon's Affordable Heat Pump Program covers 100% of a heat pump project up to $24,000 for households under an after-tax income line. Everyone else can get 50% up to $10,500. Windows pay $120 each up to $1,800, wood heat 50% up to $2,500, and the Dependable Grid Program pays 50% up to $15,000 for non-electric heating.
faq: How much is the Yukon heat pump rebate?
50% of project costs up to $10,500. Lower-income households can instead apply to the Affordable Heat Pump Program, which covers 100% up to $24,000 if approved before installation.
What is the income limit for the Affordable Heat Pump Program?
After-tax household income under $53,820 for 1 resident, $110,400 for 2, $139,150 for 3, $163,300 for 4 and $184,000 for 5 or more.
For the Affordable Heat Pump Program, yes. Anything installed before approval is not eligible, though you can still apply for the 50% rebate.
Can I get both the heat pump rebate and the Dependable Grid rebate?
The Dependable Grid dual fuel rebate is for electric-heated homes that add a heat pump plus a non-electric backup. We show the larger of overlapping heat pump offers, not the sum.

programs.name: Affordable Heat Pump Program (income-based)
programs.rules: Approval before installing. Home at least 6 months old, owned, primary residence. Keep existing heat as backup.

programs.name: Good Energy heat pump rebate
programs.rules: 50% of project costs. Cold climate air source or ENERGY STAR ground source. Home at least 6 months old.

programs.name: Dependable Grid: dual fuel (heat pump plus non-electric backup)
programs.rules: 50% of costs. Home with electric primary heating. The non-electric backup must run in a power outage.

programs.name: Dependable Grid: primary oil or propane heating
programs.rules: 50% of costs for an existing home with electric heat installing a primary oil or propane system.

programs.name: Good Energy wood heating rebate
programs.rules: 50% of costs. EPA-listed system. Building at least 5 years old.

programs.name: Good Energy ENERGY STAR window rebate
programs.rules: $120 per window up to $1,800 per home. Complete ENERGY STAR window assemblies.

programs.name: Good Energy insulation and air sealing

amount.label: Up to $12,000 walls, $2,500 attic, $5,000 air sealing

programs.rules: Energy assessment before and after. Home at least 5 years old. Shown but not added to your total.

programs.name: National Heat Pump Rebate (federal, not open yet)
programs.rules: Announced October 8, 2026 and expected to launch in early 2027. The income line, eligible homes and how it combines with provincial programs are not published, so this is shown but not added to your total.

notes: The Better Buildings program is financing repaid through a local improvement tax, so it is not added to your total.
Amounts are the most a program pays. Your rebate depends on your quote and final invoice.
